narr: A warm front lifting north and an approaching shortwave trough combined to produce scattered showers and thunderstorms across portions of southern Connecticut during the late afternoon and early evening hours. These storms resulted in isolated flash flooding in Fairfield County. CoCoRaHS observations show a narrow swatch of 1.5-2 inches of rainfall across the far southern portion of the county, including 1.54 inches at a station 2.9 miles NNW of Bridgeport.
ev: Fern Street in Bridgeport was closed due to flooding.
lsr: FERN STREET CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
